criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies untimely company ROFR waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 10 and timeline state the Company waiver is dated Jan 6, 2025, two days after the 15-day Company Notice Period expired Jan 4, 2025.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Cites correct documents for ROFR timing issue
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites the Dec 20 Transfer Notice, the Jan 6 Company waiver letter, and ROFR §2.1(b) 15-day period.

criteria_results.reasoning: Memo calls the late waiver 'harmless' (Company deemed to decline) and does not explain risk of deemed exercise or invalidation of the waiver.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends action for ROFR timing defect
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends obtaining the Board resolution/consent supporting the waiver, forwarding confirmation, and a bring-down acknowledgment.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Recommends obtaining Ridgeline co-sale waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a signed Ridgeline waiver of Co-Sale rights before Closing or waiting for periods to expire after documented forwarding.
